title: Transcendental residue enlargement in an Artinian local algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $B$ be an Artinian local $k$-algebra, and let $A_0\subseteq B$ be a local admissible $k$-subalgebra [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] relative to $\mathfrak m_B$. Let $x\in B$ be a unit. Assume inclusion $A_0\to B$ is local. Write $F_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_{A_0}$ and $K=B/\mathfrak m_B$. Give $K$ an $F_0$-algebra structure compatible with $k\to F_0\to K$ and such that the image of the residue of every $a_0\in A_0$ is its residue in $B$. Assume $\alpha=\operatorname{res}_B(x)$ is transcendental over $F_0$ (the negation of [def-weil-algebraic-element]). There exist a local admissible $k$-subalgebra $A\subseteq B$ containing $A_0$ and $a\in A$ whose image in $B$ is $x$. Moreover $F=A/\mathfrak m_A$ admits an $F_0$-algebra structure compatible with the $k$-scalar tower and inclusion on residues, and $\operatorname{res}_A(a)$ is transcendental over $F_0$ and generates $F$ as an intermediate field: $F_0(\operatorname{res}_A(a))=F$.

source.place: Tags 07FH and 07FI; geometric enlargement in steps 1, 3–10 of lem-weil-pbc-popescu-denominator-basis-enlargement, before Frobenius capture and numerator clearing. The source is also available at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FI and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH.

proof.text: The ambient B and A₀ are Artinian local. Their maximal ideals are nilpotent; admissibility supplies essential finite type and flatness of A₀ into B, and equality of the extended maximal ideal with m_B. The specified residue algebra identifies F₀ as a subfield of K. The residue of the unit x is nonzero. F₀ is essentially of finite type over k as a quotient of A₀.

*Case T: the ring $D'$ (as in 07FI, case transcendental).* Let $\theta:A_0[t]\to\bar\Lambda$ be the $A_0$-algebra map with $t\mapsto\bar s$ and $\mathfrak n=\theta^{-1}(\bar{\mathfrak m})$. Since $A_0\subseteq\bar\Lambda$ is local, $\mathfrak m_{A_0}[t]\subseteq\mathfrak n$, and modulo $\mathfrak m_{A_0}[t]$ the map $A_0[t]\to K$ is $F_0[t]\to K$, $t\mapsto\alpha$, which is injective as $\alpha$ is transcendental over $F_0$; so $\mathfrak n=\mathfrak m_{A_0}[t]$, a prime ideal ($A_0[t]/\mathfrak n=F_0[t]$ is a domain). Let $D'=A_0[t]_{\mathfrak n}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. $A_0[t]$ is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian] and so is $D'$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]. $D'/\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'=(F_0[t])_{(0)}=F_0(t)$ is a field and $\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'$ is nilpotent ($\mathfrak m_{A_0}$ is, step 1), so $\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'$ lies in every prime of $D'$ and is the maximal ideal of the local ring $D'$; $D'$ is Artinian local [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-quotient-artinian-local] (with $K=0$ there), with residue field $F_0(t)$, and $A_0\to D'$ is local. Every element of $A_0[t]\setminus\mathfrak n$ maps outside $\bar{\mathfrak m}$, i.e. to a unit of $\bar\Lambda$, so $\theta$ extends to $\psi':D'\to\bar\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], local ($\psi'^{-1}(\bar{\mathfrak m})=\mathfrak nD'$), restricting to the inclusion on $A_0$, with $\psi'(t/1)=\bar s$; on residue fields it is $F_0(t)\to K$, $t\mapsto\alpha$.

*Case T: $A=\psi'(D')$ is admissible.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-criterion-flatness-fibre-noetherian] to $R=A_0$, $S=D'$, $S'=M=\bar\Lambda$: Noetherian local rings (steps 1, 3) and local homomorphisms; $M$ is generated by $1$ and nonzero; $M/\mathfrak m_{A_0}M$ is a vector space over the field $D'/\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'$, hence free and flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; $M$ is flat over $A_0$ ($A_0$ admissible). So $\psi'$ is flat; being local it is faithfully flat [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat] and so injective [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction] ($I=0$). Let $A=\psi'(D')\cong D'$, a $k$-subalgebra of $\bar\Lambda$ containing $A_0=\psi'(A_0)$ and $\bar s$: it is Artinian local, $A\to\bar\Lambda$ is flat, and $\mathfrak m_A\bar\Lambda=\mathfrak m_{A_0}\bar\Lambda=\bar{\mathfrak m}$. Its residue field $F\subseteq K$ is the image of $F_0(t)$, i.e. $F=F_0(\alpha)\cong F_0(t)$ ($t\mapsto\alpha$), finitely generated over $k$ (by $\alpha$ and generators of $F_0$ from the initial setup). Writing $F=k(e_1,\dots,e_v)$, $F=W^{-1}k[e_1,\dots,e_v]$ with $W$ the nonzero elements of the domain $k[e_1,\dots,e_v]$, so $k\to F$ is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and by [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-essentially-finite-type-residue] $A$ is essentially of finite type over $k$. So $A$ is admissible, $A_0\subseteq A$, $\bar s\in A$. Take a to be the image of T, mapping to x in B. The residue of a is transcendental and generates F=F₀(α). Quotient functoriality supplies the scalar tower and residue compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_transcendental_residue_enlargement
    (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (A₀ : Subalgebra k B) [IsLocalRing A₀]
    (hA₀ : A₀.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
    (x : B) (hx : IsUnit x)
    [IsLocalHom A₀.val]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    [IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (hmap : ∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
        IsLocalRing.residue B (a₀ : B))
    (hα : Transcendental (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.residue B x)) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra k B) (_ : IsLocalRing A), ∃ hle : A₀ ≤ A,
      A.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧
      ∃ a : A, (a : B) = x ∧
        ∃ (alg : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)),
          letI := alg
          IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ∧
          (∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
              IsLocalRing.residue A (Subalgebra.inclusion hle a₀)) ∧
          Transcendental (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.residue A a) ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            {IsLocalRing.residue A a} = ⊤
